 X Simone Gervasio Nov 03, 2026 05:22-05:00 Translated by Dugarry hits out at Fonseca, who leaves Lyon for Sporting: “I don’t believe his crocodile tears for a second. He’s a mercenary”
 P. Fonseca Lyon Sporting CP AC Milan Roma Former French striker Christophe Dugarry has slammed former Roma and AC Milan manager Paulo Fonseca over his increasingly likely departure from Lyon to take charge of Sporting . Before returning to Portugal, Fonseca won his last match against Angers and burst into tears during the celebrations. His reaction infuriated Dugarry, who spoke about it on RMC .
 " For a long time we said players were mercenaries who only thought about money. Now it's the managers' turn. The team was built for you, there are eight months to go and you can't finish the season? I don't understand the point of any of this. A manager is someone who guides a group towards maturity, helps players improve and is happy to see them every day. A manager is a leader, a guru, a prophet , someone who leaves their mark on a career and a club. It's different from being a player."
 "I'm shocked, but we'll have to get used to it, even though it's terrible for football and for Lyon fans . But I think what's happening is terrible for football in general. It truly disgusts me. It's not right of Paulo Fonseca and it really bothers me . I don't believe his crocodile tears for a second, because anyone who gets that upset stays. Nobody forced him out."
